Maps

Data for W43-2026, updated 19 Oct 2026

Use the menu at the top left of each map to zoom on a region; hover over an area to see its figures. Grey areas have notified no cases.

Cumulative cases by health area

  • Notified cases
  • Confirmed cases
  • By health region

How to read: 34 of the country’s 117 health areas have notified at least one case, and 12 have at least one confirmed case. The Bissau region (SAB) accounts for 96 of the 181 notified cases over a small area: the “SAB (Bissau)” zoom shows its health areas.

Week-by-week evolution

How to read: move the slider or click “Play” to step through the weeks since June 2026 (week of symptom onset). Top: cases that week; bottom: cumulative since 1 June. Bissau’s health areas are small at country scale: to see them in detail, use the “SAB (Bissau)” zoom on the interactive maps above.

Status of affected health areas

Status is based on the notification date of each area’s last confirmed case: under 21 days, transmission possible; 21 to 42 days, enhanced surveillance; over 42 days, no case for two incubation periods (21 days each). Areas with no confirmed case are listed if they notified a suspected case in the last 21 days. Current count: 4 area(s) where transmission is possible, 4 under enhanced surveillance, 4 with no case for more than 42 days.

INASA and MINSAP Guinea-Bissau, with WHO support
